results.description:
Can you relate with the following?
- You don’t know when your next oil change is due?
- You want to be prepared when taking your vehicle for servicing?
- You do your own maintenance and want to keep detailed records
- You love your car very much and want to extend it's lifespan and safety

If you nodded yes, this app is for you! Keep comprehensive maintenance records, set reminders, and stay on top of your vehicle's health—right from your iOS devices.

- Service Reminders - 
Never miss a maintenance milestone. Preloaded reminders cover all the essentials, grouped by category for easy organization. Here's a glimpse:
- Fluids: oil change, transmission fluid, brake fluid 
- Filters: cabin and air filter replacement
- Tires: tire rotations, wheel alignment
- Battery: annual checkup of your battery, battery replacement
- Engine: spark plugs, timing belt
- Brakes: Service brakes, replace brake pads

Fully customize reminders based on your vehicle’s recommended intervals, or add your own to reflect specific needs.

- Widget: At-a-Glance Overview - 
Stay informed with a Home Screen widget that highlights your car's health at a glance. Each category is color-coded, letting you see which maintenance tasks are coming up soon.

- Notifications: You’ll never miss an oil change again! - 
Get timely reminders to update your vehicle’s mileage (weekly or monthly) and perform essential maintenance, with alerts 1 month, 1 week, or right when it’s due.

- 100% Privacy for Your Data -
Your data stays on your device and is securely stored in your iCloud—no third-party access, ever. Sync across all your devices seamlessly.

- Add Attachments - 
Document every detail by attaching photos to your maintenance records. Upload receipts from dealerships and/or include photos of parts or components replaced. Attachments are securely stored in your iCloud Drive, accessible on all your devices.

- Export with ease - 
Export your maintenance records in PDF or CSV format. Perfect for sharing or personal backups.

Keep your car running smoothly, extend its lifespan, and stay safe on the road. Start tracking your vehicle’s maintenance today!

Oil Change Reminder does one thing properly: it tells you when your car is next due for an oil change.

WHICHEVER COMES FIRST
Manufacturers never write a service interval as just a date. They write it as "12 months or 12,000 miles, whichever comes first." Most reminder apps only understand the date half, which quietly gives the wrong answer to anyone who drives a lot. This app tracks both halves and tells you which one is going to run out first.

Set each car to time only, distance only, or both.

IT LEARNS HOW MUCH YOU DRIVE
A mileage limit is no use if you have to open an app every week to check it. Enter your odometer now and then, and Oil Change Reminder works out roughly how far you drive per day — so it can turn "600 miles to go" into a date, and remind you on it.

EVERY CAR IN THE GARAGE
Cars, vans, motorcycles, boats. The free app keeps one vehicle; the full version keeps as many as you like. Each one gets its own interval, its own colour and its own reminders. A glance at the garage tells you which are fine and which need booking in.

YOUR HISTORY, KEPT
Every oil change you log — date, mileage, oil type, filter, cost, workshop — stays with the car. It all syncs through your own private iCloud account, so a new phone picks up exactly where the old one left off.

BUILT PROPERLY
• Miles or kilometres, your choice
• Reminders at a time of day you pick, with a heads-up before the due date
• Odometer check-ins, so distance tracking stays accurate
• Works fully offline
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Your data is yours: it lives on your devices and in your iCloud, nowhere else

Made for iPhone and iPad.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL UNLOCK
Every feature above is free for one vehicle — reminders, full history, iCloud sync, no ads and no tracking. Keeping more than one car takes a single one-time purchase. No subscription, ever.

Car Oil Change Tracker is the easiest way to stay on top of your car’s oil changes and overall maintenance. Whether you own one vehicle or several, this app will help you keep track of oil changes, set reminders, and log kilometers with ease. Don’t worry about missing an oil change or forgetting when it’s due—our app will notify you when it’s time!

Key Features:
Add Multiple Cars: Easily manage oil changes for all your vehicles in one place.
Oil Change Reminders: Set custom reminders based on time or kilometers driven.
Kilometer Log: Keep a log of your car’s kilometers to monitor usage and set accurate maintenance intervals.
Service History: Track previous oil changes and view your car’s maintenance history.
Simple & Intuitive Interface: User-friendly design for easy navigation and tracking.
Why Use Car Oil Change Tracker?
Regular oil changes are essential for maintaining your car's performance and prolonging its engine life. With Car Oil Change Tracker, you’ll never miss a scheduled oil change again, ensuring your vehicle stays in top condition. The app helps you keep your maintenance records organized, letting you focus on driving with peace of mind.

OilTrack — Oil Change Reminder

Never miss an oil change again. OilTrack tracks your vehicle's mileage and predicts exactly when your next oil change is due — so you can stay on top of maintenance without thinking about it.

How it works

Add your vehicle and set your oil change interval. Log odometer readings as you drive. OilTrack does the rest — calculating how many kilometres remain and estimating your next service date based on your real driving habits.

Features

Track multiple odometer readings with dates and categories
See remaining kilometres and estimated service date at a glance
Get notified when your oil change is approaching
View your full mileage history with charts and daily averages
Export your data to CSV for your records
Dark mode support

With Oili, you can book a remote oil change in WA, OR, and CA.

You can easily add and manage the vehicles you would like serviced by scanning their VIN or by inputting the vehicle information yourself.

You can also add and manage the locations you frequently get an oil change at. Most people fill in "home," or "work/work parking lot."

Once those are saved, booking an Oili is a breeze. Simply choose a date and time for the service to take place. Let them know how to get the keys to your vehicle and you're good to go.

If you have specific instructions on how to get the keys to your vehicle or if something comes up and you need to change the date of an appointment, you can contact the technician through either the in-app chat, or by calling them directly.

And with that, you can set it and forget it! Oil changes have never been easier.

Vehicle Maintenance Tracker (VMT) is a simple yet powerful tool designed to help you keep a complete history of your vehicles’ maintenance. Whether you're tracking a single car or managing a fleet, VMT makes it easy to stay organized and informed.

Key Features:
*Add and update vehicle details, including photo, VIN, license plate, year, make, model, tire size, oil filter type, current odometer, and annual maintenance costs.
*Set, view, and reset due dates for upcoming services.
*Archive vehicles you no longer own and restore or permanently delete them at any time.
*Manage maintenance records for multiple vehicles—oil changes, brakes, tires, batteries, and more.
*Attach photos of maintenance receipts for better documentation.
*Search and filter maintenance records easily.
*Maintenance entries are organized and sorted chronologically for quick reference.
*Export or email vehicle data in CSV format for printing or sharing.

I hope you enjoy using VMT as much as I enjoyed building it. If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to reach out—and don't forget to join the **VMT community on Facebook**! It's the best way to connect with me and other users, get updates, and suggest new features.

Happy Tracking!

Find the right engine oil for your vehicle in seconds.

OilFinderPro helps you check recommended oil viscosity, capacity, manufacturer approvals, API and ACEA standards, and compatible oil products—all in one place.

Search by make, model, year and engine, or use VIN lookup to identify your vehicle details. OilFinderPro turns complex technical specifications into clear information you can use before buying oil or visiting a repair shop.

KEY FEATURES

• Search by make, model, year and engine
• Find your vehicle using its VIN
• Check recommended oil viscosity
• View engine oil capacity
• Review manufacturer oil approvals
• Check API and ACEA requirements
• Compare compatible oil products
• Select and share oil options
• Save oil-change records for multiple vehicles
• No account required to search

FIND THE CORRECT OIL SPECIFICATIONS

See the essential requirements for your selected vehicle and engine, including viscosity grades, oil capacity, OEM approvals and recognised industry standards.

COMPARE COMPATIBLE OILS

Review oil products that match the displayed requirements. Select suitable options and share them with a mechanic, customer, friend or family member.

SEARCH USING VIN

Enter your 17-character VIN to identify available vehicle details automatically and reduce manual selection.

SAVE YOUR OIL-CHANGE HISTORY

Keep previous searches and oil-change records organised for all your vehicles.

BUILT FOR

• Car owners preparing for an oil change
• DIY mechanics checking oil requirements
• Drivers comparing engine oil products
• Professionals who need quick access to oil specifications

IMPORTANT

Oil requirements may vary by engine, model year, market, operating conditions and manufacturer updates. Always confirm the selected vehicle and engine, and consult the owner’s manual or vehicle manufacturer before servicing.
